def matches_segments(path: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
    # Publication decisions: a star matches within one path segment only, so
    # "/teams/*/badge.png" does not publish "/teams/west/drafts/badge.png".
    path_parts = path.split("/")
    pattern_parts = pattern.split("/")
    if len(path_parts) != len(pattern_parts):
        return False
    return all(fnmatchcase(part, pat) for part, pat in zip(path_parts, pattern_parts))
EOF

def test_route_star_does_not_span_nested_directories():
    service = AssetService({
        "/teams/west/badge.png": b"PNG",
        "/teams/west/drafts/badge.png": b"draft",
    })
    assert service.fetch("/teams/west/badge.png") == (200, b"PNG")
    assert service.fetch("/teams/west/drafts/badge.png")[0] == 403
    assert not service.is_public("/teams/west/drafts/badge.png")
EOF
